Name: EasyGifting
Author: CeruleanSpirit
Description:
[list]
[*]Villagers glow blue if :
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- they haven't recieved a gift today AND
﻿ ﻿- they haven't received their 2 gifts this week[list]
[*]Villagers glow red if :
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- they haven't recieved a gift today AND
﻿ ﻿- they haven't received more then 2 gifts this week AND
﻿ ﻿- it's their birthday today
[list]
[*]Otherwise, villagers return to their normal state.
[/list]
[list]
[*][i][b]NOTE[/b] : You have to be acquainted with a villager for them to glow for you.[/i]
[/list][i]
[/i][list]
[*][b]Version 1.3[/b] Adds a manual trigger replacing the "[i]always on[/i]" feature of version 1.2
[/list] ﻿The default trigger key is [b]Backspace[/b]. This key, when pressed, will start/stop the monitoring of villagers.

[list]
[*][i][b]NOTE[/b] : If you prefer not bothering with starting and stopping of the monitoring, version 1.2 is still available for download.[/i]
[/list][b]
[/b][list]
[*][b]Version 2.0[/b]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Corrected typo in displayed message: Stoped -> Stopped.
﻿ ﻿- Now starts on its own after load and then it can be stopped and started manualy by pressing the action key.
﻿ ﻿- Villagers are no longer glowing. Instead, a gift appears over their heads for those which haven't received all their weekly gifts.
﻿ ﻿  And a birthday cake appears over their heads if it's their birthday.

[list]
[*][b]Version 2.1[/b]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Now complies with the spouse gifting rule.

[list]
[*][b]Version 3.1[/b]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Now complies with Stardew Valley 1.3.36 and SMAPI 2.11.2
